nodes.label: MyBookSpace (Android book reader app)
nodes.rationale: Built to read PDF books on an old Galaxy Tab A the way you read on a Kindle, because nothing on Android felt right.

nodes.label: Battery design: nothing runs while a page is on screen
nodes.norm_label: battery design: nothing runs while a page is on screen
nodes.rationale: No timers, animation or background work while a page is displayed. The target tablet has an LCD, so dark themes do not save power on it; lower brightness does.

nodes.label: Limits (no text search, reflow, table of contents; no password-protected PDFs)
nodes.norm_label: limits (no text search, reflow, table of contents; no password-protected pdfs)
nodes.rationale: PdfRenderer gives pixels, not text, so there is no text search, text reflow or table of contents; highlights mark an area rather than words; password-protected PDFs cannot be opened.

nodes.label: Plain Java, no libraries (75 KB APK)
nodes.norm_label: plain java, no libraries (75 kb apk)
nodes.rationale: Using only Android's built-in PdfRenderer with no libraries keeps the APK about 75 KB and lets it run on a tablet with 2 GB of RAM.

nodes.label: Internal package name app.folio.reader
nodes.rationale: The package name is kept from the app's first name so that updates install over older versions.

nodes.label: Signing key folio-debug.keystore (FOLIO_KEYSTORE)
nodes.rationale: Keep the key: Android only accepts an update signed with the same key, otherwise the app has to be uninstalled first, which deletes the library.
